category: Data Processing Policies, Processes, and Procedures (CT.PO-P)
subcategory_text: Policies, processes, and procedures for enabling data review, transfer, sharing or disclosure, alteration, and deletion are established and in place (e.g., to maintain data quality, manage data retention).
informative_references: NIST SP 800-53 Rev. 5: SI-12 (Information Management and Retention), DM-1 (Minimization)
Aligned with NIST CSF 2.0 PR.DS-P1 (data quality)
implementation_examples: Define policies, processes, and procedures for enabling review, transfer, sharing, disclosure, alteration, and deletion of data, with retention rules that support data quality and minimise retention
Define the people, processes, and tooling that exercise each data action under explicit request
Ensure the policies support both individual-initiated and system-initiated flows
assessment_objectives: Determine whether policies for review, transfer, sharing, disclosure, alteration, and deletion exist
Determine whether the policies define request, approval, and execution roles
Determine whether retention rules support minimisation and data quality
Determine whether the policies cover both individual- and system-initiated flows
